patch_description: This crossover version emphasizes shorter-horizon, regime-invariant signals while keeping the feature set compact and robust. It combines the strongest ideas from the prior programs: rolling z-scores, volatility/trend-change features, momentum × volatility interactions, and light winsorization. It also reduces feature horizons overall to better survive the train→test→val regime shift, while slightly increasing model expressivity to help prevent prediction collapse toward the mean. The feature count remains well below the 80-feature limit and all features use only past data.
